action.command:
cd /workspace/project && timeout 300 python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request,urllib.parse,time
now=int(time.time()); wk=now-7*86400
def hn(q,extra=""):
    u=f"https://hn.algolia.com/api/v1/search_by_date?query={urllib.parse.quote(q)}&tags=story&numericFilters=created_at_i>{wk}{extra}&hitsPerPage=20"
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(u,timeout=40) as x: d=json.load(x)
    except Exception as e: print("err",q,e); return []
    return d.get("hits",[])
terms=["uncensored LLM","free API credits","free GPU","Show HN LLM API","free tier inference","VPS free trial","free credits AI","uncensored model","serverless GPU free","SSH free"]
seen=set()
for t in terms:
    hs=hn(t)
    for h in hs:
        title=(h.get("title") or "")
        url=h.get("url") or f"https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id={h['objectID']}"
        if url in seen: continue
        seen.add(url)
        low=title.lower()
        if any(k in low for k in ["llm","ai","gpu","api","free","credit","uncensored","vps","ssh","inference","model","trial"]):
            print(f"[{h.get('created_at','')[:10]}] {title[:80]}\n     {url}")
PY
